items.headline: Alibaba releases Qwen2.5-Omni-7B multimodal model
items.summary: Qwen2.5-Omni-7B is an open end-to-end multimodal model that takes text, images, audio and video and streams text and speech, using a Thinker-Talker architecture. It is available on Hugging Face, ModelScope, DashScope and Qwen Chat.
